summary: Full backend + frontend testing of multi-country liquidation dispatcher, recalculate endpoint, and Offboarding Detail Dialog. All requested behaviors verified working end-to-end on preview URL.

minor.issue: Response body only exposes country_code/applicable_law/concepts_not_applicable nested under `liquidation` key, not at top level. Record is correctly persisted with those fields on the row. Consider mirroring top-level for parity with GET listing response.

issues: NET TOTAL can go negative when deductions (loans) > gross (e.g., resignation with active loan showed $-38,924.36). Mathematically correct but consider surfacing an explicit 'Employee owes company' state instead of a red-flagged negative currency.

action_items: Optional: also mirror country_code/applicable_law/concepts_not_applicable at the top level of POST /offboarding response (currently only nested under `.liquidation`).
Optional UX: handle negative net (deductions > gross) with an explicit label instead of $-nnn.
critical_code_review_comments: calculate_liquidation dispatcher cleanly handles DO/US and falls back to DO with verify_local_law=True for unmapped countries.
Country alias mapping is duplicated between create_offboarding and recalculate_offboarding (~10 lines). Consider extracting to a helper _resolve_country_code(company_id) to keep them in sync.
recalculate_offboarding correctly rejects processed/approved with 400. Good.
OffboardingSection Detail Dialog: uses IIFE inside JSX (line 503-678, 175 lines). Consider extracting to <OffboardingDetailBody selectedRecord ...> for readability, but not blocking.
handleRecalculate has no loading state on the Select — rapid toggles could interleave requests. Consider disabling the select while awaiting axios.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 passed, 1 skipped — no processed records exist)

seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 1 TEST offboarding for María González during test_create_offboarding_stores_country_fields.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-country liquidation (DO/US) dispatcher + recalculate endpoint verified. Detail dialog on Offboarding tab (People Ops → Offboarding) fully working: type/country badges, applicable_law italic line, monthly/daily salary with ÷23.83 divisor note, always-visible Preaviso/Cesantía rows with legal reason ('Art. 76 y 80 C.T.') on Resignation, live recalculation via Select in draft/pending records. Tested with existing demo agency records for María González (base_salary=$75k, 1.59 years). NET flips: $153,060.53 (Despido) ↔ $-38,924.36 (Renuncia, negative due to $73.5k loan).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found.
